features.name: friedman_core_signal
features.description: Approximation of the Friedman function core: 10*sin(pi*X1*X2) + 20*(X3-0.5)^2 + 10*X4 + 5*X5, normalized to [0,1] range using known theoretical bounds. This captures the primary nonlinear interaction structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly encodes the known Friedman regression surface as a smooth continuous score, providing a near-linear projection of the decision boundary for linear SVM.

features.name: x1_x2_interaction
features.description: Product interaction between X1 and X2, which are the primary interacting variables in the Friedman function. Captures multiplicative joint effect.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes the X1*X2 multiplicative interaction for the SVM hyperplane, enabling the linear kernel to capture this nonlinear relationship.

features.name: x3_quadratic_deviation
features.description: Squared deviation of X3 from its midpoint 0.5, capturing the quadratic component of X3 in the Friedman function.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes the quadratic X3 term so the linear SVM can exploit this parabolic feature without needing a polynomial kernel.

features.name: high_signal_composite
features.description: Weighted sum emphasizing X4 and X5 which have linear contributions, plus the X1*X2 interaction term, normalized by sum of weights.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth weighted composite of the most predictive linear and interaction terms, directly useful as a margin-aligned feature for linear SVM.

features.name: noise_feature_mean
features.description: Mean of the noise features X6 through X10, which are irrelevant to the Friedman function. Low values indicate the noise features are collectively below average.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes noise features into a single dimension; the SVM can assign near-zero weight to this feature, effectively ignoring noise variables.

features.name: signal_to_noise_ratio
features.description: Ratio of signal features mean (X1-X5) to noise features mean (X6-X10), offset to avoid division by zero. Higher values indicate signal dominance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a ratio feature that contrasts signal and noise variable groups, useful for linear SVM to learn differential weighting between feature groups.

features.name: x4_x5_linear_sum
features.description: Weighted linear combination of X4 and X5 with their relative Friedman weights (2:1 ratio), normalized to unit range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the linear portion of the Friedman function with correct relative weights, providing a smooth continuous score aligned with the decision boundary.

features.name: x1_x2_sqrt_interaction
features.description: Square root of the X1*X2 product, approximating the sine interaction term behavior for small values and providing a smoother nonlinear feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a concave transformation of the X1*X2 interaction that better approximates the sin(pi*X1*X2) term, improving linear separability.

features.name: feature_variance_spread
features.description: Standard deviation proxy of all 10 features computed as mean absolute deviation from the row mean, indicating how spread out the feature values are.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures within-row variability of signal features relative to overall mean, providing a dispersion measure that may correlate with decision boundary regions.

features.name: x3_centered_abs
features.description: Absolute deviation of X3 from 0.5, measuring how far X3 is from its midpoint. Related to the quadratic X3 term but with linear growth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear approximation to the quadratic X3 deviation term, complementing the squared version and giving the SVM additional flexibility.

features.name: high_x4_low_x3_indicator
features.description: Soft indicator score for rows where X4 is high (above 0.6) and X3 is near its midpoint (between 0.3 and 0.7), representing a region where the Friedman function tends to be elevated due to strong X4 contribution with moderate X3 quadratic penalty.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies a specific feature space region with elevated signal, providing a soft binary-like feature that helps the linear SVM partition this region.

features.name: combined_friedman_score
features.description: Full composite score combining all Friedman-relevant terms: X1*X2 interaction, X3 quadratic deviation, X4 linear, and X5 linear, with log1p smoothing for numerical stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Log-compressed version of the Friedman composite score provides a smooth normalized feature with reduced skewness, improving linear SVM margin estimation.
